title: SAPHIR — measured conditions from a file
description: SAPHIR experiment whose chamber conditions do not come from the archive (no access to the Z: drive, or an older day): choose 'Measured — from a file you provide' on the 'Where and when' step, press 'Template …' to get the CSV with the recognised columns, fill in what you measured (time + any of T, p, H2O or RH, flow, roof, jNO2 …, NO, NO2, O3) and pick that file. Every missing column falls back to the typed constants; photolysis frequencies missing from the file are modelled from the file's jNO2. All SAPHIR chamber effects keep their standard defaults; add injections on the 'Injections' step.
